note: app.uniswap.org/swap with Sell=ETH and Buy=GIZA on Base, chosen through the token picker UI (never through the URL). Structural capture of the two token selectors plus the page-level chain signals. No page HTML, no scripts, no wallet connected. Captured with Playwright MCP, read-only.

urlAfterSelection.note: Watched for 3.5s in 500ms frames after the selection settled, and again on a later tick. The URL NEVER gains chain= or outputCurrency= for a UI-chosen token. The defect is not a delayed URL write; there is no URL write at all.

pageChainSignals.note: There is no page-level network selector on the swap form. The only network control is 'tokens-network-filter-trigger' (with 'all-networks-logo' when unfiltered), which exists ONLY inside the open token-picker modal and is a search filter, not the form's state. The chain lives exclusively on each token button's badge, and the chain id is carried in the badge's data-testid — nowhere else.

chainBadge.note: 8453 = Base. The chain id appears ONLY in data-testid. The alt is the empty string and there is no title or aria-label, which is why the old attribute scan (data-chain-id / img[alt] / [title]) found nothing.
1 = Ethereum. The Sell side carries its own, different badge, so a page-wide scan would see two chains at once. Reading must stay scoped to the Buy row.

beforeSelection.note: The default /swap page has NOTHING in the Buy slot: Sell=ETH, Buy='Select token', no logo and no badge in the Buy row. The honest line for that page is 'Select a token…', never 'Select a network to check ETH'.

tokenPickerRows.note: Search results in the picker use data-testid='token-option-<chainId>-<SYMBOL>' and carry the same 'network-logo-<chainId>' badge. GIZA returned entries on chains 1, 8453 (several), 42161 and 137.
